speaker: The Chairman
text: Supplementary Estimates of Expenditure for the financial year 1 April 2020 to 31 March 2021, contained in Paper Cmd 27 of 2020.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I shall deal first with the Heads of Expenditure in respect of which amendments stand on the Order Paper Supplement.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I shall now deal with the remaining Heads of Expenditure in respect of which no amendment stands on the Order Paper Supplement.

speaker: The Chairman
text: In respect of the Main Estimates, they are Heads I, K, L, M, O, Q, T, W and X of the Supplementary Main Estimates.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I propose to take those Heads of Expenditure en bloc.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I will now take the Supplementary Development Estimates.

speaker: The Chairman
text: In respect of the Supplementary Development Estimates, it is Head L.
